blurb: Guests participate in English riding lessons focusing on hunter/jumper, dressage, and eventing using classical training. The farm offers summer camps with riding lessons and horsemanship activities for ages 6 and up. Equine Supported Wellness programs involve unmounted interactions with horses for personal growth and learning.
extraNote: Payment by cash or e-transfer at beginning of month · Riders should arrive 20 minutes before lesson and stay 20 minutes after for grooming and tacking · Year round
